description: This PHP source file contains utility functions related to AOP (Aspect-Oriented Programming) in the SuiteCRM project. The functions manage assignment fields in the UI, check if AOP is enabled, retrieve email settings, and parse email templates with custom logic.

methods.name: getAOPAssignField
methods.description: Generates HTML select and input elements for assigning roles or security groups based on provided values.

methods.name: getAOPAssignFieldDetailView
methods.description: Creates a detail view representation of the assignment field, displaying the selected role or security group.

methods.name: isAOPEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether AOP (Aspect-Oriented Programming) is enabled in the global configuration.

methods.name: getPortalEmailSettings
methods.description: Retrieves email settings for the portal, falling back to admin settings if not configured.

methods.name: aop_parse_template
methods.description: Parses email templates to handle custom fields and specific bean types, integrating with the email template system.
